app.name: Blue-Collar Services
app.tagline: Skilled hands. Trusted work. Right nearby.

hero.title: Skilled hands. Trusted work. Right nearby.
hero.subtitle: Find verified plumbers, electricians, carpenters, painters and cleaners near you, with transparent pricing and real customer reviews.

landing.howTitle: Three steps to a job well done
landing.step1Text: We show verified workers closest to you first, on a map and in a list.
landing.step2Text: Every worker lists their service prices up front. Many are negotiable.
landing.step3Text: Pick a time slot, get the job done, then rate the work for others.
landing.ctaText: Set your own prices, choose when you’re available, and get bookings from customers nearby.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: From quick fixes to home improvements, connect with the skills your community needs.

desc.electrical: Wiring, switches, fans and appliance repair.
desc.carpentry: Furniture repair, doors, shelves and fittings.
desc.cleaning: Home deep clean, kitchen, bathroom, office.
desc.appliance_repair: AC, fridge, washing machine, TV and more.
desc.vehicle_rental: Rent cars, bikes and scooters by the day.
desc.car_wash: Doorstep car wash, interior cleaning, detailing.
desc.bike_wash: Bike wash, polish and chain cleaning.
desc.mechanic: Car and bike repair, servicing, breakdown help.
